title: Fixed Knee Cross Table and Vertical Head Mill
description: One newly authored complete fixed vertical knee-mill-style exterior. A broad cast foot supports a full tapered rear column and one continuous forward L knee with a lower elevating-post appearance. Two distinct perpendicular guide and carriage stages support a whole wide empty table with three actual top-open and end-open T-section channels. A high fixed ram joins a separate tall stepped vertical head and exposed quill with a short blunt spindle. A rear high drive-housing appearance and whole upper cover complete the head assembly. Three full open-spoke control wheels belong to the table end, cross saddle and knee; a separate finite head lever and blank column control complete the machine. No old drill press, shaper or lathe geometry imported. Unlike a drill column with a small bored arm table and unlike a horizontal ram/clapper shaper, the full crossed saddle and long transverse table work visually below a tall independent vertical spindle head. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. One prop zero scenes. No workpiece, sharp cutter, motor internals, actual feeds, machining, accuracy, thread/guide fits, fixture compatibility, manufacture, operator fit, load or machinery safety claimed. Rigging animation interaction not made.
